audit.title: Push-Based Feeds API Reference

dimensions.name: Answer-first extractability
dimensions.analysis: Strong opening — "retrieve the feeds through the `AggregatorV3Interface` and the proxy address." Each function section leads with a purpose sentence. Weak: no self-contained "what is a push-based feed / DataLink feed" answer at the top.

dimensions.name: Structural scannability & chunkability
dimensions.analysis: Strong; no action needed. 8 headings, 0 level skips, a function-index table, sections median 50 words (Measured facts) — ideal chunk sizes.

dimensions.name: Concrete statistics & specifics
dimensions.analysis: Weak. 0 numerals in prose (Measured facts). No update cadence, heartbeat, deviation threshold, supported networks, or decimal examples — all high-lift facts for feed docs.

dimensions.name: Citations & authoritative references
dimensions.analysis: One authoritative external link to the `AggregatorV3Interface` source on GitHub (primary source); 7 internal links. Adequate but could cite the data feeds spec/glossary.

dimensions.name: Quotable canonical definitions
dimensions.analysis: No crisp one-sentence definition of `AggregatorV3Interface` or "DataLink push-based feed." The interface is described by usage, not defined.

dimensions.name: Machine-readability & metadata
dimensions.analysis: Weak. 0 JSON-LD blocks, canonical MISSING, no datePublished/dateModified, no og/twitter tags (Measured facts). Head metadata could not be verified — CLI should pass raw `<head>`.

dimensions.name: Code completeness & agent-runnability
dimensions.analysis: All 3 substantive Solidity blocks lack imports; `PROXY_CONTRACT_ADDRESS` is used but never assigned; no pragma or contract scaffold; no expected return-value examples.

dimensions.name: Query/intent coverage
dimensions.analysis: Covers the function surface but no "how do I read the latest price," no troubleshooting, no error strings, no full-lifecycle setup→read→debug path.

dimensions.name: Clarity, fluency & terminology consistency
dimensions.analysis: Strong; consistent naming of `AggregatorV3Interface` and proxy. No action needed.

audit.summary: This is a clean, well-structured API reference for reading Chainlink DataLink push-based feeds via `AggregatorV3Interface`. Its biggest strength is scannability — tight sections, a function index table, and consistent per-function layout that chunk cleanly for RAG. Its biggest opportunities are machine-readability (no JSON-LD, no canonical, no dates per Measured facts) and agent-runnability (every code block omits imports and leaves `PROXY_CONTRACT_ADDRESS` undefined). The honest verdict: solid bones, but thin on the specifics and metadata that generative engines reward, and missing the symptom-phrased entry points devs actually query.

recommendations.title: Add symptom/intent-phrased sections
recommendations.issue: page is concept-titled only; no "how do I read the latest price" entry.
recommendations.change: add H2/H3s phrased as queries: "How do I read the latest price from a DataLink feed?", "What does `answer` return and how do I convert it with `decimals()`?", "Why is `answeredInRound` deprecated?"
recommendations.why: devs and agents query by task/symptom; concept-titled prose loses retrieval the body text would otherwise win.

recommendations.title: Add page-level metadata
recommendations.issue: canonical MISSING, no JSON-LD, no dateModified (Measured facts).
recommendations.change: emit `TechArticle` JSON-LD with `headline`, `dateModified`, `programmingLanguage: Solidity`, and a canonical URL; surface a visible "Last updated" line.
recommendations.why: structured metadata and freshness signals make the page parseable and trustworthy to agents.

recommendations.title: Make code blocks self-contained and runnable
recommendations.where: the constructor snippet and all function blocks
recommendations.change: add `// SPDX` + `pragma solidity ^0.8;`, the `import {AggregatorV3Interface} from "...";` line, and a concrete example proxy address (with network label) or a clearly-declared constant, plus a sample `latestRoundData()` return.
recommendations.why: copy-pasteable, fully-specified snippets are cited and reused far more by coding agents.

recommendations.title: Add a canonical one-sentence definition
recommendations.issue: "Import this interface to your contract and use it..." — usage, not definition.
recommendations.change: lead with "The `AggregatorV3Interface` is the Solidity interface used to read Chainlink DataLink push-based feed data from a proxy contract; it exposes `decimals`, `description`, `getRoundData`, `latestRoundData`, and `version`."
recommendations.why: a crisp liftable definition outperforms diffuse explanation for verbatim citation.

recommendations.title: Add concrete specifics for feeds
recommendations.issue: 0 numerals in prose (Measured facts); no example values.
recommendations.change: state typical `decimals()` values (e.g., 8 for USD pairs), show a sample `answer`/`updatedAt` pair, and name supported networks or link to the network list.
recommendations.why: quantitative specifics are among the highest-lift changes for source visibility.

recommendations.title: Explicitly mark the deprecated field as a Don't
recommendations.issue: deprecation is noted but not phrased as guidance.
recommendations.change: add "Don't rely on `answeredInRound` — it is deprecated; use `updatedAt` for staleness checks."
recommendations.why: naming the tempting-wrong pattern prevents engines from synthesizing outdated usage from priors.

recommendations.title: Cite the canonical data-feeds concept page
recommendations.issue: "DataLink feeds" links to a tutorial only.
recommendations.change: add an inline link to the DataLink overview/glossary and to the Data Feeds `latestRoundData` reference for cross-linking authority.
recommendations.why: internal canonical-hub links raise credibility and help retrieval route into this page.

antiPatterns: Code snippets missing imports and config across all substantive blocks (Measured facts: 3 of 3 need imports, show none).
Undefined identifier `PROXY_CONTRACT_ADDRESS` used as if assigned.
Stale/undated content: no dateModified or visible last-updated signal.
No keyword stuffing or marketing fluff — clean.
offPageNotes: `llms.txt` is referenced at the top — good; confirm this page is enumerated there and in the sitemap.
Site-level `TechArticle` schema and freshness cadence are template-level fixes best applied across the DataLink section, not just here.
CLI did not capture `<head>`; pass raw head HTML next run to fully verify canonical/JSON-LD rather than infer absence.
